title: Perception Fabric / Permission-Gated Multi-Source Active Sensing

workpackages.title: PerceptionSource registry, capability plane and immutable permission snapshots
acceptance: source registry supports 0..N configured sources and does not assume four sources
typed webcam/display/browser-visual/browser-structural/user-activity sources
SEE/ANALYZE/MEMORY/RAW_RETENTION/REMOTE_FRAME/EXTERNAL_VLM grants
permission digest binds admitted observation operations
queued intent revalidates current permission before execution
COMPUTE_OFF/OUTPUT_OFF/MEMORY_OFF remain mechanically distinct
revocation tests fail closed

workpackages.title: Single-owner multi-source CaptureBroker and bounded FrameRef rings
acceptance: CaptureOwner/Broker state machine and fan-out are fully implemented before local handoff
exactly one capture owner per physical/logical source
multiple read-only consumers supported
bounded RAM/age queues
stale frame dropping/backpressure
source add/remove/rebind works without assuming fixed source cardinality
duplicate device-open / Device-busy falsifier
real local OS/device adapter can plug into the prebuilt CaptureOwner interface without redesign

workpackages.title: Continuous token-free Retina L0 event stream
acceptance: quality/delta/motion/freshness/continuity signals
static sources collapse to sparse events
no required LLM/VLM token invocation
explicit physical resource telemetry

workpackages.title: GRID10 ObserveIntent attention bridge
acceptance: bottom-up salient change can create bounded attention candidate
top-down VisualNeed/completion deficit can create ObserveIntent
source/ROI/heads/freshness/priority/budget/permission snapshot digest/provenance bound
intent has zero observation/truth authority
execution fails closed when permission snapshot is revoked/stale/unverifiable
stale intents expire

workpackages.title: Dynamic 0..4 Retina/Cortex analysis worker pool with resource guard
acceptance: max four analysis slots initially independent of total source count
zero workers allowed while capture/cheap Retina continues
N sources greater than worker count is handled by scheduling/backpressure
workers never become independent world/state authorities
bounded queues and measurable admission/backpressure
perception load cannot violate admitted cognitive/control resource envelope

workpackages.title: Browser dual Retina and privacy-bounded user-activity source
acceptance: visual rendered view and structural DOM/AX view remain independent
cross-view disagreement is preserved
active app/window/focus/idle/activity-rate signals are permission-gated
raw keylogging/clipboard/password-field capture absent from baseline source

workpackages.title: Temporal multi-source fusion and typed world-model ingress
acceptance: source_time/capture_monotonic/clock_domain/generation/freshness/provenance preserved
cross-clock claims carry bounded clock uncertainty or explicit UNKNOWN
fusion uses an explicit admissible temporal window/skew policy
arrival order is never silently treated as event-time order
stale or temporally unaligned evidence cannot silently become current state
multi-view disagreement survives fusion
world model receives typed compact state/evidence instead of canonicalizing frames

workpackages.title: PerceptionWorldBridge, ROI re-look and explicit VLM escalation
acceptance: typed events cross VPS bridge by default
raw/ROI transfer requires REMOTE_FRAME at actual transfer time
generic VLM escalation requires EXTERNAL_VLM at actual dispatch time
permission snapshot digest is checked before remote/VLM execution
cheapest adequate sensing ladder enforced
bridge loss/reconnect cannot replay stale permission or fork state identity

workpackages.title: Perception dashboard, audit and cardinality/time/no-VLM soak acceptance
acceptance: dashboard per-source/per-capability control
global pause Retina and all-sensors-off
live worker/source/reason visibility
audit trail for capture/analysis/remote/VLM decisions
0-source case keeps cognition healthy and fabricates no observation
1-source basic path passes
N-sources-greater-than-workers scheduling path passes
sustained four-source synthetic/VPS soak with zero general-VLM calls and bounded RAM when four sources can be synthesized
source churn and permission-revoke-during-queued-intent tests pass
clock-skew/uncertainty test prevents false contemporaneous fusion
final local real-device repeat with Claude Code/Opus before product acceptance

claim_rule: Each workpackage requires normal create-only ownership/claim before mutation and normal receipt/reconciliation evidence. This extension itself does not mark any workpackage accepted.
completion_rule: Phase-7 perception integration is incomplete until F2-WP-707 through F2-WP-715 are either accepted at their explicit scopes or superseded by an owner-approved equivalent with equal or stronger acceptance coverage. The hardening contract is part of those acceptance semantics.
